title: Will vs be going to (Future) - Future forms comparison

options.answer: I will going to buy a car tomorrow.
I am going to buy a car tomorrow.
I going to buy a car tomorrow.

explanation.en: Use 'be going to' for planned future actions. The correct form is 'am/is/are + going to + base verb'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'be going to' для запланированных будущих действий. Правильная форма: 'am/is/are + going to + базовый глагол'.
explanation.uz: Rejalashtirilgan kelajak harakatlar uchun 'be going to' dan foydalaning. To'g'ri shakl: 'am/is/are + going to + asosiy fe'l'.

options.answer: She will helps you with your homework.
She will help you with your homework.
She will to help you with your homework.

explanation.en: Use 'will + base form of the verb' for spontaneous decisions or predictions. Don't add 's' or 'to' after 'will'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'will + базовая форма глагола' для спонтанных решений или предсказаний. Не добавляйте 's' или 'to' после 'will'.
explanation.uz: O'z-o'zidan qabul qilingan qarorlar yoki bashoratlar uchun 'will + fe'lning asosiy shakli' dan foydalaning. 'will' dan keyin 's' yoki 'to' qo'shmang.

options.answer: Look at those clouds! It will rain.
Look at those clouds! It going to rain.
Look at those clouds! It will going to rain.

explanation.en: Use 'will' for predictions based on what you think will happen. Use 'going to' for predictions based on present evidence.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'will' для предсказаний, основанных на том, что вы думаете произойдет. Используйте 'going to' для предсказаний, основанных на видимых доказательствах.
explanation.uz: Nima bo'lishini o'ylashingiz asosida bashorat qilish uchun 'will' dan foydalaning. Hozirgi dalillarga asoslangan bashoratlar uchun 'going to' dan foydalaning.

options.answer: We are going to visit Paris next month.
We going to visit Paris next month.
We will going to visit Paris next month.

explanation.en: Use 'be going to' for plans made before speaking. The correct form includes the auxiliary verb 'be'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'be going to' для планов, составленных до момента речи. Правильная форма включает вспомогательный глагол 'be'.
explanation.uz: Gapirishdan oldin tuzilgan rejalar uchun 'be going to' dan foydalaning. To'g'ri shaklda yordamchi fe'l 'be' mavjud.

options.answer: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
I think it is going to be sunny tomorrow.
I think it will going to be sunny tomorrow.

explanation.en: Both 'will' and 'going to' can be used for predictions, but 'going to' is often preferred for weather predictions based on current conditions.
explanation.ru: И 'will', и 'going to' могут использоваться для предсказаний, но 'going to' часто предпочтительнее для прогнозов погоды, основанных на текущих условиях.
explanation.uz: Ham 'will', ham 'going to' bashoratlar uchun ishlatilishi mumkin, lekin hozirgi sharoitlarga asoslangan ob-havo prognozlari uchun 'going to' ko'pincha afzalroq.

explanation.en: Use 'will' for spontaneous promises or decisions made at the moment of speaking.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'will' для спонтанных обещаний или решений, принятых в момент речи.
explanation.uz: Gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan o'z-o'zidan va'dalar yoki qarorlar uchun 'will' dan foydalaning.

explanation.uz: Oldindan rejalashtirilgan harakatlar uchun 'be going to' dan foydalaning. Strukturada yordamchi fe'l 'be' to'g'ri tuslanishi kerak.

options.answer: Maybe I will go to the party tonight.
Maybe I am going to go to the party tonight.

explanation.en: Use 'will' for uncertain future events or possibilities. 'Will' is commonly used with words like 'maybe', 'probably', 'perhaps'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'will' для неопределенных будущих событий или возможностей. 'Will' обычно используется со словами как 'maybe', 'probably', 'perhaps'.
explanation.uz: Noaniq kelajak hodisalar yoki imkoniyatlar uchun 'will' dan foydalaning. 'Will' odatda 'maybe', 'probably', 'perhaps' kabi so'zlar bilan ishlatiladi.
